CustomField.description: Internal loop-protection counter: a JSON map of Flow Api Name to the number of times the dispatch trigger has launched it for this submission in the current run. Reset when a Start event fires. Written only by the Form_Submission_Convert trigger via FormSubmission_LoopGuard; not for admin use.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Internal plumbing for conversion loop protection. Do not edit.
CustomField.label: Conversion Dispatch Counts
